d: Big ideas meet extraordinary cake decorating at Carlo’s Bakery. Buddy Valastro and his team take on creative challenges that call for imagination, precision and expert baking skills. Their elaborate custom cakes showcase the possibilities of professional cake decorating, with unique designs and themed creations that are as impressive to look at as they are ambitious to make. Relive the standout moments from this baking reality show and discover what makes Cake Boss a favorite among cake lovers, only on discovery+ India.
